# infoblox_named_list (List Resource)

Retrieves a list of Infoblox NamedList from the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// List specific Named Lists using filters
list "infoblox_named_list" "list_named_list_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      type = "custom_list"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List specific Named Lists using Tags
list "infoblox_named_list" "list_named_list_using_tags" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    tag_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// List Named Lists with resource details included
list "infoblox_named_list" "list_named_list_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filters are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes (e.g. name, view). If multiple filters are specified, only resources that match all of them are returned.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to filter results by UDDI tags. Only applicable for the UDDI backend.
